notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Steelfin Whale.
Steelfin Whale does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, triggering Steelfin Whale, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.
